rationale: Source is a design brainstorm with a recommended option (C), an explicit 'Does NOT exist' list, an impact table naming ~13 concrete files, and a 4-part 'Research directives' section. Verbs are additive ('extend', 'new', 'reuse'), not failure verbs. The job is to confirm/refute each existence claim against real code and to find the patterns the new usage plane must follow -> enrichment.

queries.intent: Full API outline of the top ledger events page returned by Q005.
Follow typed edges from the sdd_coder engine page to find its usage/telemetry neighbours.
Follow typed edges from the AbstractClient page to find who consumes its usage output.
Read the LedgerEventKind enum and LedgerEvent envelope verbatim - the exact extension point for usage.* kinds.
Read the ledger index: table DDL, reducers, migration/versioning pattern a usage plane must follow.
Read sdd_coder/telemetry.py in full - confirm or refute that a telemetry sink already exists.
Locate every place a provider usage payload is parsed in the client layer.
Find the execution boundary methods in the sdd_coder engine to see what is available to accumulate per execution_id.
Confirm whether a normalised Usage/TokenUsage model already exists anywhere in parrot.
Read clients/budget.py - existing token budget accounting that the usage plane may subscribe to instead of duplicating.
Read coder_feedback.py - the per-execution plane whose key and retry-dedup rule the usage plane is supposed to copy.
Read LedgerService.from_root / export_snapshot / compact / audit signatures to see what a new plane inherits for free.
Read the shared append-only log to confirm the concurrency guarantees claimed for multi-worktree writers.
Find any existing OTel wiring in the repo (env vars, exporters, collector config).
Read the Claude Code settings for this repo: which hooks are registered and whether telemetry env vars are set.
List the hook scripts actually present, to size the new SessionStart/SubagentStop hooks.
Read the sdd state schema fields that identify the current task/attempt, so a hook can resolve cwd -> feat_id -> task_id deterministically.
Read the sdd_coder toolkit to see the exact MCP tool surface coder_end_execution exposes today.
Confirm whether report_usage exists in the memory/compaction subsystem or is design-only.
Locate how codex is invoked as a coder backend and whether --json / the event stream is parsed.
Read the codex dispatcher located by Q029 to see stdout handling and whether usage events are available.
Read the local Codex config to determine whether an [otel] block / telemetry export is configured or supported.
Read the sdd_coder roster to see the seat/model vocabulary the usage plane must key on (seat, backend, model).
Find the wikitoolkit CLI group registration site for a future 'usage' group.
Check whether the local MCP CLI exposes ledger targets that a usage target would sit beside.
Recent history of the ledger package - the migration/compaction pattern in motion and any in-flight work that would collide.
Recent history of sdd_coder - how fast the execution boundary is changing under a new ingestor.
Recent history of the client layer - whether usage extraction was touched recently.
Recent history of .claude/hooks and settings - the hook surface's stability.
Any prior attempt at usage/cost accounting in this repo, merged or abandoned.
Find existing tests for the ledger planes - the test pattern a usage plane must match.
Confirm the correlation key vocabulary actually used across the coder planes (task_id, attempt_uid, execution_id, backend, model).
Read the ledger store to see how a plane persists and queries rows.

expected_findings: Whether a normalised Usage/token object already exists in AbstractClient, and which of the four counters survive
The exact LedgerEventKind enum and LedgerEvent envelope, plus the index DDL/migration pattern a usage plane must follow
Whether sdd_coder/telemetry.py and clients/budget.py already provide a usage sink the brainstorm missed
The real execution lifecycle around coder_begin_execution/coder_end_execution and where a client instance is reachable per execution_id
The dedup rule coder_feedback.py uses, confirmed verbatim, as the model for usage idempotency
What the SDD plugin's hook surface looks like today and what a SessionStart/SubagentStop hook would cost
Whether parrot already has an OTel/observability subsystem that the collector lane could reuse
How codex is spawned today and whether its JSON event stream is already parsed
Which of the brainstorm's 'Does NOT exist' claims are true, and which are already partly built

external_probes.intent: Pin the Claude Code and Codex CLI versions against the feature gates named in the source (agent_id >= 2.1.310, raw bodies >= 2.1.274).
Determine whether the Codex CLI exposes OTel export, a session id, and a --json usage event, from its own help/config surface.

Verify, against official Claude Code documentation, the three attribution facts the source marks 'implied, not stated': parent session.id on sub-agent api_request events, agent.name population, and query_source=auxiliary coverage.
